azure-deals.description: Azure-hosted enterprise deal revenue by product SKU, plus a separate sales order log of customer orders and order amounts - overlapping order and customer vocabulary with storefront and warehouse.
azure-deals.title: Azure Deals

fin-ledger.description: Restricted financial ledger: confidential deal memos, acquisition budgets, and revenue figures, accounting records - access limited to the deal team.
fin-ledger.title: Finance Ledger

hr-haystack.description: Internal team status memos and quarterly updates from Finance, Operations, Marketing, Engineering, Design, Legal, Product, Procurement, Facilities, and Customer Success - initiatives, town halls, budget reviews, vendor plans. A large filler/distractor corpus alongside the HR wiki; not itself HR policy content.
hr-haystack.title: HR Haystack

hr-wiki.description: Company HR policy library: parental leave and vacation entitlements, holiday calendar, benefits, onboarding program, expense and equipment policies, remote work, performance reviews, code of conduct, and security awareness training.
hr-wiki.title: HR Wiki

storefront.description: Retail storefront customer orders (order id, customer, item, amount) and per-product unit sales totals - overlapping order and customer vocabulary with warehouse fulfillment history.
storefront.title: Storefront Orders and Sales

support-tickets.description: Customer support ticket log tracking product defects and complaints (screen, battery, and hardware issues) by product SKU.
support-tickets.title: Support Tickets

synapse.description: Marketing spend and campaign performance data: paid search, paid social, social, email, and display advertising spend by region (US, EMEA, APAC) and channel.
synapse.title: Synapse Marketing Analytics

warehouse.description: Warehouse fulfillment order history by customer (item, amount) - a separate ledger from storefront orders, sharing order and customer vocabulary with storefront.
warehouse.title: Warehouse Order History

warehouse-reviews.description: Customer product review roundups written by the warehouse team, one per product (desk lamp, cable organizer, standing desk, bookshelf, office chair) - praised features, complaints, and unit sales volume commentary.
warehouse-reviews.title: Warehouse Product Reviews
